Keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <debug_state.bin> <output> build/gpt2_124M.bin` loads the GPT-2 124M weights, runs a forward pass with targets on the debug batch, zeroes the gradients, runs the backward pass, and writes raw float32: the gradient of every parameter (model.num_parameters values, in llm.c's parameter order), then the mean loss, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output against PyTorch's within 0.02 absolute (llm.c's own test tolerance), so use precise math (sycl::exp, not native::exp). cuBLAS calls go to oneMath (oneapi::math::blas::column_major gemm and gemm_batch, #include <oneapi/math.hpp>; the compile flags already link -lonemath). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: delete migrate's output under migrated/ (delete_file) once your own port is done. The files are long: read them in parts (read_file offset/limit).
